why: 2CH 35:9: 'Conaniah, and Shemaiah and Nethanel his brethren (אחיו)', all chiefs of the Levites under Josiah. Not recorded with nethanel-9.
2SA 21:22 says 'these four were born to the giant (להרפה) in Gath', and the four include Goliath the Gittite (21:19). Not recorded.
2KI 25:22 sets Gedaliah over 'the people that remained in the land of Judah', the land. Not the patriarch Judah.
'Jehoshaphat king of Judah' (מלך־יהודה) names the kingdom, not the person Judah son of Jacob.
MAT 13:55 names Joseph (Ἰωσήφ) and Judas together as Jesus' brothers, so they are brothers to each other.
2CH 29:2: 'according to all that David his father (דויד אביו) had done'. Not recorded.
2CH 29:12's Kish son of Abdi lived in Hezekiah's day. The abdi record is the son of Malluch in Ethan's ancestry (1CH 6:44), centuries earlier; the father is abdi-3.
2SA 4:2 says 'of the children of Benjamin' but adds 'for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin', a territorial reckoning of a Gibeonite town. Descent from Benjamin is not decided.
GEN 16:3: Sarai gave Hagar to Abram 'to be his wife' (לו לאשה). The chapter calls her wife, not concubine.
JHN 11:27: Martha confesses σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ. Not recorded.
2CH 35:9's Nethanel is a chief Levite under Josiah. nethanel-4 is the scribe of David's time (1CH 24:6), a different man.
2KI 16:2: 'like David his father (כדוד אביו)'. David is not recorded as Ahaz's ancestor.
2CH 28:1: 'like David his father (כדויד אביו)'. Not recorded.
Joah son of Zimmah is stated in 1CH 6:21 (the joah-2 record), and 2CH 29:12 again reads 'Joah son of Zimmah' (יואח בן־זמה). The father link is true.

JDG 4:11 calls Hobab חתן משה, Moses' in-law/father-in-law, but the site already records moses brother-in-law-of hobab from NUM 10:29 (Hobab son of Reuel). Which is right is the old Hobab/Reuel question, not settled here.
1KI 11:18-20: Pharaoh gave Hadad a house, food, land and a wife, and Hadad 'found great favour'. Hospitality and patronage, not master-of; nor does it say this is Solomon's father-in-law.
MRK 15:40: Μαρία ἡ Ἰακώβου τοῦ μικροῦ καὶ Ἰωσῆτος μήτηρ, mother of Joses as well as of James. Only the James link is recorded.
2CH 29:12's Abdi is the Hezekiah-era Merarite father of Kish (abdi-3). He is not Malluch's son of 1CH 6:44.
1CH 27:3: 'Of the children of Perez (מן־בני־פרץ) was the chief ... for the first month', i.e. Jashobeam son of Zabdiel (27:2). Not recorded.
1CH 12:3's Azmaveth is the Benjamite father of Jeziel and Pelet at Ziklag (azmaveth-6). Jehoadda's son is five generations after Jonathan.
MAT 13:55 lists Simon and Joseph together among Jesus' brothers, so they are brothers.
MRK 15:39: the centurion says Ἀληθῶς οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος Υἱὸς Θεοῦ ἦν. Not recorded.
NEH 11:4: 'Of the children of Judah (מבני יהודה); Athaiah son of Uzziah ... of the children of Perez'. Not recorded.
JER 36:12's Zedekiah son of Hananiah is a prince under Jehoiakim. Nothing ties his father to the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur of Gibeon (JER 28:1); hananiah-13 is the named father.
2CH 21:2 lists Azariah among Jehoram's brothers. Only killer-of is recorded.
1CH 27:25: Jehonathan's father is a David-era Uzziah (uzziah-4), not Uriel's son in the old Kohathite line of 1CH 6:24.
GEN 28:13: 'the LORD God of Abraham thy father (אברהם אביך)', to Jacob, so Abraham is his forefather. Only the Isaac links are recorded, nothing directly between them.
MAT 13:55 names James and Simon together as Jesus' brothers, so they are brothers to each other.
2KI 18:3: 'according to all that David his father (דוד אביו) did'. Not recorded.
EZR 4:8: 'Shimshai the scribe' (ספרא) wrote with Rehum to Artaxerxes against Jerusalem. He was a provincial scribe writing to the king, not the king's scribe.

LUK 1:5 says only ἐξ ἐφημερίας Ἀβιά, 'of the course of Abijah'. Course membership was priestly-familial, but the post-exilic courses were reconstituted under the old names, so descent from Abijah is not decided.
2CH 21:2 lists Zechariah among Jehoram's brothers. Only killer-of is recorded.
1CH 12:6 'the Korhites' (הקרחים) come in a list of Benjamites (12:2), and many read them as a Benjamite or Judahite Korah family (cf. 1CH 2:43) rather than Levites from Izhar's son Korah.
2KI 18:1: 'Hezekiah son of Ahaz king of Judah' names the kingdom, not the patriarch Judah.
2KI 21:1 does not even say 'king of Judah', and in any case the kingdom is meant, not Judah son of Jacob.

1CH 27:18's Michael is the father of David's prince of Issachar. michael-4, Izrahiah's son (1CH 7:3), is three generations after Tola, who went down to Egypt, so not David-era; michael-10 is the named father.
1CH 12:3's Azmaveth is the Benjamite father of Jeziel and Pelet at Ziklag (azmaveth-6), not Jehoadda's late descendant of Jonathan (1CH 8:36).
2CH 17:3: 'he walked in the first ways of David his father (דויד אביו)'. Not recorded.
2SA 23:24's Elhanan is son of Dodo 'of Bethlehem'. dodo-2 is the Ahohite, father of Eleazar (23:9), a different man.
1CH 12:6 'the Korhites' (הקרחים) appear among Benjamites, and their link to Korah son of Izhar (rather than another Korah, cf. 1CH 2:43) is disputed.
JDG 4:11 places Heber 'of the children of Hobab (מבני חבב)', and Hobab is Reuel's son (NUM 10:29). Heber is therefore Reuel's descendant.
2KI 12:20-21: Joash's servants slew Joash; 'Jozachar ... smote him, and he died', and Amaziah reigned in his stead. The victim is Joash, not Amaziah.
1CH 27:18's Michael is the father of Omri, David's prince of Issachar (michael-10). The Tola-line Michael of 1CH 7:3 lived centuries earlier.
EST 2:7: Esther is Mordecai's 'uncle's daughter' (בת־דדו), already recorded as cousin, whom he 'took for his own daughter' (לקחה ... לו לבת). An adoption, not daughter-of.
1CH 15:18 only lists Ben and Obed-edom side by side among the second-degree Levites/porters. No descent is stated.
1CH 12:9 numbers the Gadites 'Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third'. A ranking, not a genealogy.
JOS 17:2-3: 'Hepher son of Gilead son of Machir son of Manasseh' and 'the male children of Manasseh'. Only son-of Gilead is recorded, nothing directly to Manasseh.
2KI 15:38 buries Jotham 'in the city of David his father (דוד אביו)'. Not recorded.
1KI 15:3: 'as the heart of David his father (דוד אביו)', said of Abijam. Not recorded.
2CH 29:12: 'Mahath son of Amasai ... of the sons of the Kohathites (מן־בני הקהתי)', the same Hezekiah-era Levite as 2CH 31:13. Not recorded.
